items.headline: $SEI Perps Go Live on CFTC-Regulated OG.com
items.summary: $SEI perpetual futures now trade on CFTC-regulated OG.com Markets, with dollar-settled contracts, no expiry and 8-hour funding. A rare regulated derivatives listing for a smaller altcoin.

items.headline: $NEAR Intents Postmortem: $3.8M Exploit Traced to Bug
items.summary: $NEAR Intents published its postmortem on the $3.8 million exploit, linking it to a deposit bug. The protocol says all affected users were made whole.

items.headline: $SUI Shakeup: Mysten Labs Names New CEO
items.summary: Kevin Boon succeeds Evan Cheng as Mysten Labs CEO, with Cheng staying as CTO to lead a new AI agent infrastructure unit tied to $SUI and Walrus.

items.headline: $HYPE Powers Ripple Prime's New RWA Perp Swaps
items.summary: Ripple Prime added RWA perpetual swaps referencing equities, ETFs, metals and energy, tied to perps listed on Hyperliquid. Another institutional nod for $HYPE's ecosystem.

items.headline: $STRK's Bold Bet: Starknet Eyes L1 Exit by 2027
items.summary: StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson explains why $STRK may leave Ethereum to become the first fully quantum-resistant L1, targeting 2027. A high-stakes pivot for the Starknet ecosystem.
